map.主导管→分支导管树枝状分布，末梢腺泡均匀充盈: Main duct -> branch duct tree-like distribution, uniform acinar filling at periphery
map.主导管扩张、腊肠样，排空延迟，可见结石性充盈缺损: Main-duct dilatation, sausage-like, delayed emptying, stone filling defect visible
map.主导管轻度扩张，末梢导管点/球状扩张: Mild main-duct dilatation, peripheral punctate/globular dilation
map.末梢导管点状→球状→囊状扩张(苹果树样)，腺体破坏: Peripheral ducts punctate -> globular -> cystic dilation (apple-tree appearance), gland destruction
map.导管抱球状移位、充盈缺损，边界清楚: Duct ball-hugging displacement, filling defect, clear border
map.导管紊乱、突然中断、造影剂外溢，边界不清: Duct disorganization, sudden interruption, contrast extravasation, unclear border

map.分支导管呈雪花样扩张，提示舍格伦综合征表现。: Branch ducts showing snowflake-like dilation suggest Sjogren syndrome.
